title: "Volume I"
subtitle: "Introduction to Machine Learning Systems"

One lecture deck for each chapter of Volume I, from the course overview to the conclusion, covering a single machine with one to eight accelerators. Each deck comes as a PDF for projection, a PowerPoint file whose notes pane holds the speaker notes, and the LaTeX source.
